findings.message: <audio> element references file(s) not found in the project: assets/music/bed.mp3. The rendered video will be silent.
findings.fixHint: Add the file "assets/music/bed.mp3" to the project directory, or update the src attribute to point to an existing file.

findings.message: <video> element references local file(s) not found in the project: assets/media/aroll.mp4, assets/media/broll.mp4. The renderer will silently skip these and produce a video with missing visuals.
findings.fixHint: Add the missing files to the project directory, or update the src attributes to point to existing files. Captured asset filenames are unreliable. Verify against capture/contact-sheets/ and capture/extracted/asset-descriptions.md.

findings.message: Font family used without @font-face declaration: kit. These are not in the auto-resolved font list, so the renderer cannot supply them automatically. Text will fall back to a generic font, producing incorrect typography in the video.
findings.fixHint: Add @font-face { font-family: '...'; src: url('capture/assets/fonts/...woff2'); } for each font family, pointing to the captured .woff2 files, or switch to a Google Fonts family. An OS font such as PingFang SC or Hiragino Sans renders locally from the installed copy, but a cloud render has no copy and refuses it.
